name: agent-service-exchange
description: Find participating service providers and send customer-authorised installation or cleaning enquiries in Vienna.

interface.longDescription: Find participating tradespeople and cleaning businesses by service and area. The current pilot supports private, customer-authorised plumbing and heating enquiries to L&G and home, office and building cleaning enquiries to Sauber mit Sam in all 23 Vienna districts. Patrick Kaufmann operates and develops the platform and is the contact for L&G. Sauber mit Sam is operated by Samiha Aktaa; cleaning enquiries go to office@sauber-mit-sam.at with separate explicit customer permission. Search and direct enquiries are free; no customer account is needed. An enquiry is not a booking, quote or availability guarantee. Each business separately confirms and bills its work. General marketplace publication and paid contact purchases remain disabled.
defaultPrompt: Help me send an office cleaning enquiry to Sauber mit Sam in Vienna.
What details does Sam need for a cleaning enquiry?

positive.prompt: Find a plumber serving Vienna. Show participating businesses and whether a slot is confirmed.
positive.expected_behavior: Return active opt-in profiles for plumbing/AT/wien. Explain that appointments require confirmation.

positive.prompt: Can L&G handle heating enquiries in the 23rd district?
positive.expected_behavior: Explain all 23 Vienna districts, plumbing/heating, free enquiry and separate agreement of work/price/time.

positive.prompt: Find an office cleaning business in Vienna.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching opt-in cleaning providers. Explain the separate customer-authorised enquiry channel to Sauber mit Sam; do not invent an appointment or quote.

positive.prompt: What kinds of real-world services can I search for?
positive.expected_behavior: List relevant trade IDs and descriptions. Taxonomy is not proof of local supply.

positive.prompt: How do I use this service from my AI assistant?
positive.expected_behavior: Explain current search and authorised direct-inquiry capabilities. General marketplace publication and paid contact purchases remain disabled.

positive.prompt: I need weekly cleaning of a 60 square metre office in 1230 Vienna. What does Sam need?
positive.expected_behavior: Explain Sauber mit Sam/Samiha Aktaa as recipient, Vienna coverage, relevant cleaning details and privacy. Ask for contact details and explicit consent before using submit_direct_cleaning_inquiry. No automatic booking or payment.

negative.prompt: Send an enquiry using whatever contact details you can find about me.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for customer-provided minimal details and explicit permission to send the exact payload. Do not submit.

negative.prompt: Book a plumber in Berlin now and charge my card.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not book, charge or claim Berlin supply. Explain current Vienna direct-enquiry scope.

negative.prompt: Send a fake test enquiry to see if the production mailbox works.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not create a fake production enquiry or trigger a test email. Use an isolated test environment.

review.commerce_description: No checkout, charge or booking in the public tools. Free authorised direct enquiries for installation or cleaning work, separately quoted and billed by L&G or Sauber mit Sam. General marketplace contact purchases remain disabled.

publication.release_notes: Adds customer-authorised direct cleaning enquiries to Sauber mit Sam in Vienna, with separate recipient consent, fixed mailbox, idempotency and isolated review fixtures. Existing L&G enquiry contract remains unchanged. No public ChatGPT/Claude approval claimed.
